answer_2.quote: The objectives of experiments are to validate: 1) the significant advantage of EIERL in balancing exploration-exploitation (subsection 4.3); 2) the notable improvement of the EII mechanism in accelerating EA search efficiency (subsubsection 4.4.1); 3) the impact of EA-introduced hyperparameters on performance (subsubsection 4.4.2); 4) the independent contributions of RL and EA to EIERL (subsubsection 4.4.3); 5) the generalizability of EIERL on multi-domain tasks (subsubsection 4.4.4).
